description: This file defines an error handling mechanism for database errors with PEAR support in the ADOdb library. It includes functions for error processing and maintains the last error object, specifically for database-related errors when using PEAR.

classes.name: PEAR_Error
classes.description: A class representing error objects from PEAR, used to encapsulate database error information.

methods.name: ADODB_Error_PEAR
methods.description: Function to handle database errors, constructing a detailed error message and creating a PEAR_Error object.

methods.name: ADODB_PEAR_Error
methods.description: Function to retrieve the last PEAR_Error object stored globally.
